posts.post:
you’re either a ‘keep the tags on for an hour’ person or a ‘rip them off while still in the fitting room’ person.

no in-between.

wearing socks with sandals is a personality test.

i’ve decided it’s a genius move.
there is nothing more humbling than realizing your favorite outfit makes you look exactly like your mother.
people who buy full-price items and then hide them in the closet for a month before wearing them need a group chat.
